review_text: Fits my office drawer and works well for one cup.
I take it camping because there is no battery to charge.
The folding handle and pouch make packing straightforward.
Grind felt consistent for my pour-over routine.
Thirty grams is not enough when friends visit.
I could not remember the adjustment setting.
The loose grounds brush away quickly.
Fine grounds remain around the adjustment gap.
The black version feels solid in my hand.
Silver looks good on my desk.
